g.text: numbers above each database: % of its structures that gained a value it never reported itself
1,637,460 of 6,266,517 structures (26.1%) carry at least one value their own database never reported, and 3,204,768 of 40,798,399 filled cells (7.9%) come from elsewhere.
Independently of who arrived first, 3,153,748 crystals (22.9% of all that carry a value) draw their property record from two or more databases
carried after the other 54 are merged on
